ex.en: Contact your card issuer if your card is lost.
ex.zh: 卡片遺失時，請聯絡發卡銀行。

ex.en: The bond issuer must pay interest every year.
ex.zh: 債券發行人每年必須支付利息。

issuer.en: a company or bank that officially provides cards, shares or documents

ex.en: The issuance of new shares raised two million dollars.
ex.zh: 發行新股募得兩百萬美元。

ex.en: Visa issuance usually takes five working days.
ex.zh: 簽證核發通常需要五個工作天。

issuance.en: the act of officially giving out or supplying something

ex.en: Many elderly people suffer from isolation.
ex.zh: 很多長者飽受孤單之苦。

ex.en: Working from home can lead to a sense of isolation.
ex.zh: 在家工作可能會讓人有孤立感。

isolation.en: the state of being alone or apart from other people

ex.en: The patient was kept in isolation for two weeks.
ex.zh: 那名病患被隔離了兩週。

ex.en: Travelers had to stay in isolation at a hotel.
ex.zh: 旅客必須在飯店隔離。

isolation.en: the act of keeping a sick person away from others

ex.en: Several cottages have been isolated by the flood water.
ex.zh: 好幾間小屋被洪水圍困，與外界隔絕。

ex.en: Patients with the virus were isolated from others.
ex.zh: 感染病毒的病人被隔離了。

ex.en: Working from home made him feel isolated.
ex.zh: 在家工作讓他覺得很孤立。

isolate.en: to keep someone or something apart from others

ex.en: Engineers isolated the cause of the problem.
ex.zh: 工程師找出了問題的原因。

ex.en: We need to isolate the faulty part.
ex.zh: 我們需要找出故障的零件。

isolate.en: to find and separate one part from the rest in order to study it

ex.en: Several cottages have been isolated by the flood water.
ex.zh: 好幾間小屋被洪水圍困，與外界隔絕。

ex.en: Many elderly people feel isolated after their children move away.
ex.zh: 許多長輩在孩子搬走後覺得很孤單。

isolated.en: far from other places or cut off from other people

ex.en: Seen from a plane, that island is very beautiful.
ex.zh: 從飛機上看，那座島非常美。

ex.en: No one lived on the island at that time.
ex.zh: 那時候島上沒有人住。

ex.en: A massive earthquake of magnitude 8.8 hit the Japanese islands today.
ex.zh: 今天，規模 8.8 的強烈地震侵襲了日本列島。

island.en: a piece of land with water all around it

ex.en: We have issues we have to deal with.
ex.zh: 我們有一些必須處理的問題。

ex.en: This issue has nothing to do with you.
ex.zh: 這件事跟你無關。

ex.en: She has dropped out of school due to health issues.
ex.zh: 她因為健康問題休學了。

issue.en: a subject or problem that people discuss or must deal with

ex.en: The meteorological bureau has issued a red rainstorm alert.
ex.zh: 氣象局發布了豪雨紅色警報。

ex.en: The magazine is issued twice a month.
ex.zh: 這本雜誌每個月出刊兩次。

issue.en: to officially announce, give out or supply something

ex.en: They spent a quiet week on a small isle in the Pacific.
ex.zh: 他們在太平洋的一座小島上度過安靜的一週。

ex.en: The British Isles include Great Britain and Ireland.
ex.zh: 不列顛群島包括大不列顛島和愛爾蘭。

ex.en: She bought some fresh Israeli oranges at the market.
ex.zh: 她在市場買了一些新鮮的以色列橘子。

ex.en: The Israeli team arrived at the airport this morning.
ex.zh: 以色列代表隊今天早上抵達機場。

ex.en: An Israeli I met on the trip taught me a few Hebrew words.
ex.zh: 我在旅途中認識的一位以色列人教了我幾個希伯來文單字。

ex.en: Many Israelis serve in the army when they are young.
ex.zh: 許多以色列人年輕時會服兵役。

ex.en: The museum displays beautiful Islamic art and calligraphy.
ex.zh: 博物館展出了精美的伊斯蘭藝術與書法。

ex.en: Islamic architecture often features tall domes and decorated arches.
ex.zh: 伊斯蘭建築常有高聳的圓頂和裝飾華麗的拱門。

ex.en: Israel is a country in the Middle East.
ex.zh: 以色列是中東的一個國家。

ex.en: Jerusalem is a city many visitors to Israel want to see.
ex.zh: 耶路撒冷是許多到以色列的遊客想參觀的城市。

ex.en: Islam is one of the major religions in the world.
ex.zh: 伊斯蘭教是世界主要宗教之一。

ex.en: The class learned about the history of Islam.
ex.zh: 這堂課學習了伊斯蘭教的歷史。

ex.en: Isabel always keeps a small notebook in her bag.
ex.zh: 伊莎貝爾包包裡總是放著一本小筆記本。

ex.en: We waited for Isabel at the station for twenty minutes.
ex.zh: 我們在車站等了伊莎貝爾二十分鐘。
